persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.

messages.text: Can you make a meme using this attached cat pic? I've had one of those weeks where I keep getting the day wrong, so this feels very relatable. I want it to be square, with the top text saying exactly "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY" and the bottom text saying exactly "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY". The cat's expression is what made me want to do this in the first place. Please use big white letters with black outlines, and keep the cat's eyes clear.
